description: This Java source file defines 'MainActivity', an Android activity that manages camera preview and video recording using MediaRecorder and Camera APIs. It handles user interactions to start/stop recording, manages camera lifecycle, and prepares media recording sessions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling camera preview and video recording functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout and references to UI components.

methods.name: onCaptureClick
methods.description: Handles user interaction for starting and stopping video recording.

methods.name: setCaptureButtonText
methods.description: Sets the text label of the capture button.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases camera and media recorder resources when activity pauses.

methods.name: prepareVideoRecorder
methods.description: Configures camera and MediaRecorder for video recording.

methods.name: MediaPrepareTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to prepare media recorder asynchronously and manage recording start.
